title: Stack Allocator
description: Write a Zig program that implements a simple fixed-buffer stack allocator for memory management.
verificationTest: output.includes('Allocated block sizes: 4 and 8') && output.includes('Total used: 12/1024')
hints: A stack allocator increments an offset as memory is allocated
Use `orelse return` to handle allocation failures
The buffer is a slice `[]u8` referencing a fixed-size array
`start..end` slice syntax creates sub-slices of the buffer
